en: A sepia-toned image showing a lush, tree-covered landscape with a dramatic rocky outcrop and the ruins of fortifications on top. In the foreground are several buildings with classic European architecture. The lower right corner contains printed text in French and German, identifying the location as 'Luxembourg' and referencing 'Les Rochers du Bock.' Additional text below indicates it is a hand-colored artist postcard and provides a publisher's name and address.
